article.story: CLEMSON, S.C. -- — Cole Certa scored a season-high 20 points and grabbed seven rebounds as Clemson rolled past The Citadel 87-51 on Monday night. Certa, a junior transfer from Notre Dame, was 7-for-9 from the field (3-for-5 from beyond the arc) and made all three of his attempts from the charity stripe for the Tigers (4-1). Dylan Faulkner, a senior transfer from Samford, scored 12 and had a team-high nine rebounds in 20 minutes. Harris Reynolds and Chase Thompson each had 11 points, and Ace Buckner dished six assists. The Bulldogs (3-2) kept the game close for much of the first half, as neither team led by more than four points until 1:49 remained. Clemson closed out the first half on an 8-0 run to take a 38-28 halftime lead, then continued building it in the second half. Reynolds sank two free throws and hit a 3-pointer to make it a 20-point game eight minutes into the second, and the lead would not shrink lower. The Tigers finished regulation on a 17-3 run. Aaron Ekwere led the Bulldogs with 13 points and 10 rebounds for his first collegiate double-double. Clemson holds a 62-24 series advantage against The Citadel. The Bulldogs have not beaten Clemson since 1979. Up next The Citadel: hosts South Carolina State on Friday. Clemson: plays Ole Miss in the Maui Invitational next Monday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
